title: NIST Center for Nanoscale Science and Technology NanoFab
content:
Aerogel National Laboratory. The NIST Center for Nanoscale Science and Technology (CNST) NanoFab in Gaithersburg, Maryland, is a national shared-use facility that gives researchers from industry, academia, and government rapid access to state-of-the-art commercial nanoscale measurement and fabrication tools.

Often described as a machine shop for 21st-century technology, the NanoFab combines a cleanroom with expert technical staff, user training, and flexible access models. Its fabrication and metrology capabilities support nanoscale materials work, including aerogel-related process development, coating integration, and precision characterization.
